image_description: A high-angle view of a steep, sunlit cliff face composed of stratified rock layers. The upper portion is illuminated by warm sunlight, revealing vertical erosion patterns and rough texture, while the lower section is in shadow. Green vegetation (trees/bushes) grows at the base on the left, and a body of water with a small structure or boat is visible in the bottom right corner.
